title: docs(adr): ADR-0055's Lint bullet gains a dated note stating the narrowed ownerMayEdit lint arm
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92oviX8Kae6u5irtoKdwade)_

Fixes #26686

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:ADR-0055 的 2026-10-26 修正案里 **Lint** 那一条仍写着「任何按调用者键的 update 策略都被提示加 `ownerMayEdit` 开关」。本 PR 不改那句话,只在它正下方追加一条带日期的注记(并在 Status 行同步加一条 Amended 记录),说明 #26591 / PR #26658 之后 lint 的真实行为:只有按 `owner_id` 键、且明细表确有 `owner_id` 列、尚未开启开关的策略才被建议加开关;按别的人员字段键的策略(或 `owner_id` 列不存在)无论开没开开关都会被提示,补救是「把负责人放进 `owner_id`」,从不建议开关。
- **为什么改**:ADR 是写 master-detail 应用的 agent 最先读的地方;旧句子已让 hotclm 为 `owner` 字段策略声明了开关,lint 安静了,负责人照样 403。#26591 修了 lint,ADR 还在描述旧的臂。
- **风险与回滚**:纯文档,追加式(Prime Directive 13),不动门禁、spec、lint;回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`docs/adr/0055-master-detail-controlled-by-parent.md` 第 178 行(注记)与第 7 行(Status 行新条目);两处皆为新增行,原文零改动。
- **两分钟验证**:`git diff origin/main -- docs/adr/0055-master-detail-controlled-by-parent.md`,预期只有 2 行新增、0 行删除;`pnpm check:adr-anchors && pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors` 预期绿。
- **需要你做的**:批准本 PR(受管面 `docs/adr/**`,Tier H,席位不转 ready、不入队)。

## What changes

One file, two inserted lines, nothing rewritten (ADRs are append-only, Prime Directive 13; the card's "reword that one bullet" yields to it, as the triage audit line and the retriage answer on #26686 say):

- `docs/adr/0055-master-detail-controlled-by-parent.md`, the **Lint** bullet of "What the opt-in does, exactly" (the 2026-10-26 amendment for #25760) gains a dated note directly under it, in the file's own in-place form (`⚠️ **Amended YYYY-MM-DD (#N) — …**`, the shape the 2026-10-22 and 2026-09-07 notes use). The note states the arm `main` carries since #26591 / PR #26658, read off `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` on `origin/main`:
  - the opt-in is prescribed only for an `update` / `all` policy that keys the caller on `owner_id`, on a `controlled_by_parent` detail that carries `owner_id` and has not opted in (`pushCbpOwnerPolicyWithoutOptIn`);
  - every other caller-keyed update policy (another user field such as `owner == current_user.id`, or `owner_id` on a detail with no such column) is flagged in both states, opted in or not, with the `owner_id` remedy and never the opt-in (`pushCbpCallerPolicyOffOwnerColumn`);
  - the rule id and the `warning` tier are unchanged; the rule's `os explain` entry says the same;
  - the bullet above it is kept as the arm as first landed and marked as no longer a statement of what the lint prescribes;
  - the open question (widening the runtime leg to a named owner field) is named as the maintainer's on #26591 and not decided.
- The **Status** line gains a matching `· **Amended** (2026-10-27, #26591 / PR #26658) — …` entry, because every in-place note in this file is paired with one there.

No gate, spec, lint or other ADR text changes. No changeset: `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing (`skip-changeset` sent with the create).

## Tests

None owed: a docs-only diff under `docs/adr/`, no package touched, no tested behaviour changed, so no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance read against bullet + note together: the pair no longer tells a reader that every caller-keyed policy gets the opt-in; `owner_id` is named as the one column the opt-in admits; `check:adr-anchors` is green at the head and ADR-0055 declares the same machine-readable decision-letter count at base and head (0 headings, 0 bold leads, 0 table cells on both `origin/main` 8eef9a8d and the head, by the four grammars `check-adr-anchors.mjs` reads).
- Premise re-verified on `origin/main` 8eef9a8d (the delta's 0ea90c7a has moved on): the Lint bullet is unchanged at line 176, and no open PR names `docs/adr/0055*`.
- Symbol anchors in the note are the `path#symbol` form `check:adr-symbol-anchors` resolves (`pushCbpOwnerPolicyWithoutOptIn`, `pushCbpCallerPolicyOffOwnerColumn`, `SECURITY_CBP_OWNER_POLICY_WITHOUT_OPT_IN_EXPLANATION` all exist on `origin/main`).
- `docs/adr/README.md` is generated and did not need regenerating: its status column truncates ADR-0055's value before the new entry (`check:adr-index --report` reads it current).
- Forced test edits: none.

## Verification

- Build closure (so the lint-owned gate below could load `@objectstack/lint` / `@objectstack/formula`): `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/lint...' --concurrency=2` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: `VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 102s`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (change set derived from git, 1 path vs merge base `8eef9a8d`) listed 21 commands; every one ran serially with stdin closed and recorded exit 0: `check-adr-links` (+ `--self-test`), `check-closing-keyword-parity` (+ `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `ci/plan-test-core-shards --self-test`, `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:adr-index`, `check:adr-symbol-anchors`, `check:ci-filter-parity`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-prior-rulings`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:watch-hint-literal`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran ran.txt`: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 21 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 21 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 21 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- `dispatch-gates --tier`: MANDATORY `docs/adr/**` (clause ①, no one-line exit); changed lines 2 (+2 / -0), under the 3000 human-merge threshold.
